author: @ramkrishna2910

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking change. The --spawn-server flag was already accepted on macOS; it previously failed to spawn a local server (likely crashing or hanging). Now it accepts the flag, prints a warning to stderr, and starts in disconnected mode. Existing scripts or users passing --spawn-server on macOS will see different (better) behavior but no existing working setup is broken.
evidence.documentation: Documentation is updated in two places: docs/guide/configuration/README.md gets a new 'lemonade-tray CLI (Linux/macOS)' section listing all flags with --spawn-server marked 'Linux only'. docs/dev/getting-started.md is updated to say '--spawn-server - Linux only; ignored with a warning on macOS' instead of the old description that implied macOS support via LaunchDaemon. The dev doc change is consistent with the code behavior.
evidence.manual_release_testing: No evidence a human exercised --spawn-server on macOS before this release. The PR body notes the failure was discovered during 'v2026.41 candidate testing' but does not show a successful post-fix run. The change is user-reachable: any macOS user running lemonade-tray --spawn-server will see the new warning. Since this is the release surface that changed, a tester should verify the fix works end-to-end before shipping.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval on the original PR. This cherry-picked commit (16bcf639ca) is an identical copy of 886d0cd585 on release-v2026.41.
evidence.review: PR #3756 was approved by @Geramy at 2026-10-06T16:19:04Z. @Geramy's subject-area expertise includes 'sockets, tcp/ip, udp, named pipes, mac, security, Nexus mesh compute' (docs/dev/contribute.md), so the reviewer has relevant macOS knowledge. No comments were raised during review. The PR was merged at 2026-10-06T17:24:34Z, about an hour after approval.
evidence.security: No security concern. The change adds a compile-time guard (#ifdef __APPLE__) that suppresses server spawning on macOS. It prints a warning to stderr and sets spawn_server=false, which is strictly less permissive than the old behavior. No credential handling, network calls, or supply-chain changes are introduced.
evidence.tests: No automated tests were added. The change modifies a CLI flag's behavior on macOS (prints a warning and sets spawn_server=false) and adds documentation. Testing this flag requires an actual macOS build and manual invocation; unit testing a platform-specific runtime behavior path is not currently done for this codebase. No existing tests were weakened or deleted.

maintainer_todos.text: On a macOS release candidate, run lemonade-tray --spawn-server and confirm stderr prints 'Warning: --spawn-server is not supported on macOS and will be ignored.' and that the tray launches in disconnected mode without starting a local lemond.

subject: fix(tray): make --spawn-server a no-op on macOS (#3756)
summary: Makes lemonade-tray's --spawn-server flag a no-op on macOS (prints a warning and continues in disconnected mode) and documents all lemonade-tray CLI flags in the configuration guide.
verdict_reason: The --spawn-server flag on macOS is user-visible behavior that changes from an attempted local spawn to a no-op with a warning, but no evidence shows a human exercised this path on macOS before the release.
